_note: How we ask MIRA (Phase 7). Change wording, options, questions or weights here - no code change. Raise 'version' on every change; it is saved with every check. Tuned with real data in phase L1.

template.link_unofficial: Link {n} ({domain}): NOT an official site of a known company.
template.asks: The message asks the reader to: {asks}.
template.question:
{state}
Question: {question}

phrases.sender_mobile: a mobile number (not a company sender ID)
phrases.sender_name: the sender name "{sender}" (not a known company sender ID)
phrases.age_unknown: domain age could not be checked
phrases.otx_none: no threat reports in AlienVault OTX
phrases.otx_unknown: threat reports could not be checked
phrases.ask_secret: send or enter an OTP, PIN or password
phrases.signal_prize: mentions a prize, gift, cashback or lottery
phrases.signal_urgent: uses urgency or threats (blocked, suspended, urgent, today)

questions.text: Does this message ask for an OTP, PIN, password or card number?
Does this message ask the reader to send or pay money or a fee?
Does this message say the reader won a prize, gift, cashback or lottery?
Does this message pretend to be a bank, eSewa, telecom company or government office?
Is this a normal personal conversation between people who know each other?
